messages.subject: Reg Methyl Kit
parts:
Hello,

I am using methyl kit to analyze DNA methylation.
We are trying to combine the information obtained all the differentially methylated bases with the annotation of the same.

How do we know which regions are hypo and hyper methylated from the below output:
"target.row" "dist.to.feature" "feature.name" "feature.strand"
"1418" 1 -1273 "NR_125957" "-"
"301" 2 -4565 "NM_004285" "+"
"732" 3 17635 "NM_001017975" "-"
"732.1" 4 17606 "NM_001017975" "-"
"732.2" 5 17570 "NM_001017975" "-"
"732.3" 6 17569 "NM_001017975" "-"
"732.4" 7 17564 "NM_001017975" "-"
"732.5" 8 17563 "NM_001017975" "-"
"732.6" 9 17549 "NM_001017975" "-"
"732.7" 10 17548 "NM_001017975" "-"

Please let me know.

Thanks,
Subhiksha

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] Reg Methyl Kit
parts:
"target.row" column denotes row number of the methylDiff object used in annotation. You should be able to use [] and cbind() to combine methylation information and annotation. You might want to search the forum for "target.row" and/or "getAssociationWithTSS" keywords. This has been asked multiple times, the documentation on this is not very clear.

Best,
Altuna
